consequence.statement: No operational consequence for existing setups: nothing is removed, rejected or changed; operators only gain the optional ability to simulate scenarios in CLI policy evaluation by defining global values (e.g. request.operation) and rule-specific values in the Values file instead of modifying GlobalContextEntry resources in the cluster.

assertion.statement: Kyverno CLI 1.13.0 adds the ability to inject global context entries during policy evaluation by defining global values (e.g. request.operation) and rule-specific values in a cli.kyverno.io/v1alpha1 Values file (new globalValues field), without modifying GlobalContextEntry resources in the cluster.
